theme_and_archetype.description: Lab-grade pristine, authoritative, strictly functional. Blends Swiss Brutalism with Nordic minimalism. Emphasizes scientific credibility, transparency, and strict compliance through high-contrast typography, structural grids, and deliberate absence of decorative elements.

global_rules: 95% monochrome UI. Color is function only.
Use Signal Red strictly for compliance notices and destructive actions.
Grids must have exposed structural borders (The Technical Look). Container `border-collapse`, items `border-r border-b border-black/10`.
No soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders or hard, flat shadows if absolutely necessary.
Buttons and cards must use sharp corners (`rounded-none`).
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Never use generic pharma blue or purple gradients.
Language toggle (FR/EN) must be universally accessible in the header.

typography.instructions: Avoid Inter/Roboto. Use 'tracking-tight' for headings. Monospace is crucial for peptide sequences, dosages, and compliance tags to enforce the 'lab report' aesthetic.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style or strict table grids. Items stretch to fill cells. No jagged bottoms. Override stretch with `align-items: start` when needed.

components.buttons: Square edges (`rounded-none`). Solid black for primary, bordered for secondary. Monospace text inside. Hover: invert colors or solid gray.
components.cards: Square edges, pure white, 1px solid border. No drop shadow. Hover effect: slight translate up (`-translate-y-1`) with a hard `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#050505]`.
components.inputs_and_forms: Shadcn based. Sharp corners, thick 1px bottom border only (Material style) OR full 1px square border. Floating labels if possible.
components.modals_and_sheets: Stark white surface, 1px border. Dark glass backdrop (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`).
components.badges: Square edges, monospace font. Lab/COA badges should be bordered with black text. Compliance badges in warning yellow or red.
components.icons: lucide-react. Keep stroke-width at 1.5 or 1 for a precise, technical feel.

global_header.layout: Sticky, solid white background with 1px bottom border. Left: NORDPEP bold logo. Center: Navigation. Right: [FR/EN] Toggle (monospace), Cart, Login.

age_verification_modal.design: Brutalist block centered on screen. Headline: 'RESTRICTED ACCESS'. Body: 'You must be 19+ to enter. Products are for Research Use Only.' Big primary button 'I AM 19+', secondary 'EXIT'. Destructive red accents.

homepage.hero: Split layout. Left: Massive typographic statement 'PRECISION PEPTIDES FOR CANADIAN RESEARCH'. Right: Grayscale abstract nordic ice or vial image. Strict borders between sections.
homepage.featured_products: Technical grid (`border-collapse`). Each product card is a grid cell with right and bottom borders.
homepage.trust_bar: Monospace scrolling marquee or grid showing: '3RD PARTY LAB TESTED', 'SHIPS FROM CANADA', '99.9% PURITY'.

product_catalog.layout: Left sidebar for categories (Healing, Weight Loss, Cognitive, GH Secretagogues). Right side: Product Grid.
product_catalog.cards: Image at top (vials), Monospace SKU/Sequence below, Name in Grotesk, Add to cart button filling the entire bottom of the card.

product_detail.layout: 2-column. Left: sticky image. Right: Data-heavy. Dosage/sequence info in table format. Prominent Red 'For Research Use Only - Not for Human Consumption' banner. COA/Lab report download link.

cart_drawer.layout: Slide out from right. Sharp borders. Clear total. Checkout button locked to bottom.

checkout.flow: Standard Shadcn forms. Must check 'I agree to Terms & Conditions and confirm I am 19+'.
checkout.payment_methods: Shadcn Tabs to switch between 'Interac e-Transfer' and 'NOWPayments (Crypto)'. Interac shows manual instructions upon confirmation. Crypto redirects or shows QR.

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation. Main area uses Shadcn Tables. Heavy use of monospace for Order IDs, SKUs. Color-coded status badges (Pending = Gray, Paid = Blue, Shipped = Orange, Delivered = Green).

compliance_footer.layout: Massive padding (`py-24`). Top section: Large bold disclaimers 'HEALTH CANADA NOTICE: NOT FOR HUMAN CONSUMPTION'. Bottom: standard links.

hero_abstract_ice.description: Abstract nordic glacier, high contrast. Use as hero background or graphical element.

generic_product_vials.description: Grayscale glass medical vials. Use for default product images to maintain the pristine aesthetic.

lab_environment.description: Clean, modern science lab. Use in 'About Us' or 'Quality/Lab Tested' sections.

tech_stack_instructions.language_toggle: Implement a simple React Context or Zustand store for `lang` ('en'|'fr'). Store in localStorage. Translate static strings via a simple dictionary object.
tech_stack_instructions.ui_library: Use Shadcn UI primitives but override Tailwind classes heavily to remove radii (`rounded-none`) and enforce stark borders.
